<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1590365_worksp_0.WorkspacePlanningUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>WorkspacePlanningUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var WorkspacePlanningUtils = Class.create();
WorkspacePlanningUtils.prototype = {
	initialize: function () {
	},

	getElegibleManagers: function () {
		var excludedManagers = [];
		var gaBase = new GlideAggregate('x_1590365_worksp_0_office_base');
		gaBase.addAggregate('COUNT');
		gaBase.groupBy('manager');
		gaBase.query();

		while (gaBase.next()) {
			var count = Number(gaBase.getAggregate('COUNT'));

			if (count >= 1) {
				excludedManagers.push(gaBase.getValue('manager'));
			}
		}
		var role = 'x_1590365_worksp_0.base_manager';
		var query = "roles=" + role;

		if (excludedManagers.length > 0) {
			query += "^sys_idNOT IN" + excludedManagers.join(",");
		}

		return query;
	},

	type: 'WorkspacePlanningUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-25 18:45:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>046ec506c3cd47904a9d563ed40131a2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>WorkspacePlanningUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Workspace Planning" source="x_1590365_worksp_0">ca3a548ec30947904a9d563ed4013157</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Workspace Planning">ca3a548ec30947904a9d563ed4013157</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_046ec506c3cd47904a9d563ed40131a2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-25 18:46:01</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
